title: OpCall
description: Candidate single EditCommand envelope (SDK executable name: EditCommand). D RUNNER emits canonical OpCalls in Plan.calls and journal calls. Handler ids remain open. This increment is not a schema freeze.

op.description: Qualified operation id, e.g. timeline.opacity or myteam.stagger.

select.description: Authoring selector; executed calls use the canonical stable selector resolved by the runner. null for timeline-level operations.

args.description: Opaque finite JSON operation arguments in authoring units. Omitted keys, JSON null, explicit clip.clear keys, and ordinary objects (including {$absent:true} or {op:clear}) remain distinct. Only the selected handler interprets these values.

version.description: The tool version when it ran (filled by the runner).

resolved.description: Runner-populated stable string identities. The admitted producer uses local identities; globally scoped ScopedId mapping remains unresolved and is not imposed here.
